headline: TechJuice reports that Google plans to invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic, in a deal that also gives Anthropic 5 gigawatts of Google computing capacity.
score_reason: Pool score 8 lowered by 2: the article is undated, its valuation figures predate Anthropic's May round, so this looks like older news and is unverified here.
importance_line: Anthropic's customers and rivals are affected by how much computing power Anthropic can secure, but the date and current terms of this deal are not confirmed by this article.
summary: TechJuice reports that Google will invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic, $10 billion in cash at a $350 billion valuation and $30 billion more if Anthropic meets performance targets, and that Anthropic would receive 5 gigawatts of Google computing capacity. The article gives no date and its valuation is well below the $965 billion that Business Insider reports for Anthropic in May, so this appears to describe an earlier deal rather than new news.
freshness: FOLLOW-UP of an earlier 2026 deal (date not stated in the source)
